answer: No. Your dad can sign power of attorney form NW-POA-2, which can be signed electronically with no notary; only Georgia still requires notarization. NW-POA-2 replaced the notarized NW-POA-1 on February 1, 2026, and an older NW-POA-1 was only accepted until June 30, 2026, so use NW-POA-2. When you come in, bring your own photo ID and the car's documents.
